input.summary: Kovai Finechem Pvt. Ltd. (contact R. Selvam, Sales) sent an offer (Kovai_Finechem_Offer.xlsx, own ERP format) and a sample COA for propanediol only. RESOLVED: vendor replied glycerin density 1.26 g/mL at 25C (RM-002), so kg conversion is possible. Still outstanding knockouts: Q5 COA for each line (batch no., manufacturing date, retest date), asked once, not received; Q9 SDS plus confirmation of leave-on scalp suitability under Cosmetics Rules 2020, asked once, not received. Vendor has not raised questions or refusals. Response deadline 14 Nov 2026.

input.subject: RE: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Thank you, remaining items needed
input.body:
Dear R. Selvam,

Thank you for confirming the density of refined glycerine (1.26 g/mL at 25 °C). We can now convert the RM-002 quote to kg pricing.

To complete our evaluation, please send the following by 14 November 2026:

1. Certificate of Analysis (COA) for a recent batch of each of the remaining nine lines (RM-002 to RM-010), showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date. We already have the propanediol (RM-001) COA.

2. Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each of the 10 materials, and written confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Your offer can remain in your own format. Items 1 and 2 are required before we can progress your offer.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
